description: Turn a photograph of a single object into a textured 3D mesh, downloadable as GLB (and FBX, OBJ, USDZ, STL). Reconstruction is asynchronous on the server and typically takes one to three minutes — the call blocks until the mesh is ready. Needs a clear photo of one object, as JPG or PNG. Costs 80 credits and requires the Studio plan. The GLB is downloaded to disk and its path returned.

detail.description: Mesh density: draft (12k triangles), standard (40k, default) or high (80k). Barely affects generation time.

image.description: The product photo (JPG or PNG): a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/…;base64,… URL.

output_path.description: Where to save the .glb. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output/model-<timestamp>.glb.

textured.description: Generate colour textures. Defaults to true.

name: photo_to_3d
title: Reconstruct a 3D model from a photo
